crewai.label: CrewAI
crewai.notes: Crews run with cache=False so tools run on every run, as in the other frameworks (CrewAI caches tool results by default). Flows are instantiated per run (their state lives on the instance).

scenarios.title: Agent, one model call
scenarios.detail: One model call, no tools, the model answers at once: the framework's cost per agent turn.

scenarios.title: Agent with 5 tool calls
scenarios.detail: The model asks for 5 tools, then answers; model and tools answer at once: the cost of a turn with tools.

scenarios.title: Agent with realistic delays
scenarios.detail: As above, with 200 ms per model call and 300 ms of I/O per tool: about 0.7 s if the tools run at once, 1.9 s one by one.

scenarios.title: Workflow: 10 steps in a row
scenarios.detail: Ten trivial Python nodes in a row: the cost per step.

scenarios.title: Workflow: 20 parallel nodes
scenarios.detail: Twenty Python nodes of 100 ms I/O each, then a join: about 0.1 s if they run at once.

scenarios.title: 1 agent run
scenarios.detail: One run (model 100 ms per call, one tool of 50 ms): the baseline for the load tests.

scenarios.title: 100 agent runs at once
scenarios.detail: 100 runs at the same time in one process: wall time, CPU and memory.

scenarios.title: 1000 agent runs at once
scenarios.detail: 1000 runs at the same time in one process: wall time, CPU and memory.
